test_title: PYST 8:SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

His house was **__filthy__ **with papers and eatables strewn everywhere.
solution: The correct answer is: **Clean** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Filthy **means extremely dirty or unpleasant. (अत्यंत गंदा या अप्रिय) • **For example**: *The abandoned house was filled with trash and dirt, making it look absolutely filthy.* • Marked option **Clean **means free from dirt, marks, or stains. (गंदगी, निशान या दाग से मुक्त) • **For example**: *She scrubbed the kitchen until every surface was gleaming and clean.* • Therefore, the most appropriate **antonym **of the underlined word is 'clean'. Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Dignified **means having or showing a composed or serious manner. (संयमित या गंभीर ढंग से व्यवहार करना या दिखाना) • **Integral **means necessary to make a whole complete; essential or fundamental. (संपूर्ण को संपूर्ण बनाने के लिए आवश्यक; आवश्यक या मौलिक) • **Barren **means unable to bear fruit or children; unproductive. (फल या बच्चे पैदा करने में असमर्थ; अनुर्वर) 30:T93e, The correct answer is: **I am being laughed at by her. **
